title: Gloomy domed livingroom
html_source: The tiny one room of the Martello tower’s second floor, preserved today just as it was in 1904, served as combination living room, bedroom and kitchen for Joyce, Gogarty and Trench (recreated in the novel as Stephen, Mulligan and Haines).
